description: Event catalogue for the Personal Savings Account Opening and ISA Subscription journey. Introduces 4 events: EVT-148 through EVT-151. All published by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core).

events.name: SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted
events.trigger: Customer completes and submits savings account or ISA application via channel.

derived_from.initial_deposit_amount: Customer-entered amount — not yet credited (pending account creation)

consumers.action: Trigger AML monitoring setup for new savings relationship.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.savings.
events.worm_rationale: Account application with ISA declaration recorded immutably for HMRC and regulatory audit.

events.name: SavingsAccountOpened
events.trigger: SavingsAccount successfully created with status = active (or pending_deposit).

derived_from.interest_rate_aer: SavingsAccount.interest_rate_aer — from product rate at time of opening

consumers.action: Establish AML monitoring baseline for new account.
Record for FSCS reporting and HMRC ISA notification queue.
Dispatch account opening confirmation with account number, AER, FSCS summary.
Write immutable account opening audit record.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering. SavingsAccountOpened follows SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted for same customer.
events.worm_rationale: Account opening with ISA details requires HMRC-auditable immutable record.

events.name: IsaSubscriptionUpdated
events.trigger: A deposit is made to a Cash ISA account, updating the subscription_used amount.

payload_schema.deposit_amount: string (decimal as string, GBP) — the amount that caused this update

derived_from.deposit_amount: The specific deposit that triggered this event

consumers.action: Update HMRC ISA return dataset with current subscription_used.
Write immutable ISA subscription update record for HMRC audit.

events.ordering_guarantees: Strict per-account ordering via account_id partition key — subscription_used must be monotonically increasing within a tax year.
events.worm_rationale: ISA subscription updates are HMRC-auditable. Must be immutably recorded.

events.name: SavingsDepositMade
events.trigger: A deposit is credited to a savings account (ISA or non-ISA).

derived_from.new_balance: SavingsAccount.balance after deposit — SVC-001 reads back balance post-update
derived_from.deposit_source: Determined by payment method used at PH-110

consumers.action: AML transaction monitoring — check deposit against threshold and behavioural baseline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Strict per-account ordering via account_id partition key.
